typography.primary_font_usage: Section headers (TODAY, WEEKLY PLAN, HISTORY, SETTINGS), numbers, giant focus titles. ALWAYS uppercase, tracking-normal or tight.
typography.secondary_font_usage: Body text, exercise names, inputs, and minor labels. tracking-normal.

layouts.general: Mobile-first PWA approach. Max-width constraints on desktop (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto) to mimic mobile app layout. No desktop-specific sidebars.
layouts.spacing: Dense but legible. Generous padding inside cards (p-4 to p-6). Gaps between sections (gap-6).
layouts.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom navigation bar. 4 tabs (Today, Week, History, Settings). Active state uses primary accent color. Background #0A0A0A with top border #262626. Avoid completely transparent backgrounds.

components.cards: Dark charcoal/black background (#171717). Subtle 1px solid border (#262626). No heavy drop shadows. Border radius: rounded-xl.
components.buttons: Action buttons rounded-lg. Checkmarks rounded-full. Primary buttons: bg-[#FF4500] text-white font-bold uppercase.
components.checkmarks: Rounded full buttons (w-8 h-8 or w-10 h-10). Default state: transparent with 2px border-gray-600. Completed state: bg-[#FF4500] border-[#FF4500] text-white.
components.inputs: Dark inputs for reps/duration/band-level. bg-black border-[#262626] text-white focus:border-[#FF4500] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF4500].
components.dividers: Subtle border-b border-[#262626]. Short break dividers can be dashed or include a small 'REST' label.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to eliminate pure digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.active_states: All active or completed elements must visibly shift to the primary accent color (#FF4500).
visual_enhancers.hero_banners: Image banners at the top of the Today screen should have a heavy black gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/70 to-black/30) so text is fully readable.

motion.transitions: Fast, punchy transitions (e.g., duration-150 ease-in-out) for buttons and inputs. Avoid slow fades.
motion.checkmarks: Spring animation on click (scale down then snap back up) to make logging sets feel impactful.

specific_screens.today: Header banner with day name and focus title, progress counter, exercise cards with reps/duration/band-level inputs per set, checkmark buttons, SKIP buttons, rest timer button.
specific_screens.week: Day selector strip Mon-Sun with dots for training/rest, read-only exercise list for selected day with SHORT BREAK dividers.
specific_screens.history: Stat tiles (Day Streak, X/5 This Week, Total Sessions), weekly dot tracker, recent sessions list, simple trend chart using Recharts.
specific_screens.settings: Dark mode toggle (disabled/hidden if forced dark), app info card, equipment list, 'Reset All App Data' button (danger zone - red).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on charcoal background meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Orange accent on dark background is for high-priority items.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF4500] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-black).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Strictly follow the mobile-first approach. Wrap the main app container in a max-width (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#050505]) to enforce the mobile layout even on desktop browsers.
Never use generic centered layouts for form inputs or exercise data; left-align data and right-align actions for scannability.
Never use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react strictly.
Use 2-3x more spacing inside cards to prevent a cramped look. Make touch targets large (min 44px height).
Do not use HTML-based components for advanced UI. Use Shadcn where applicable, but customize to remove the generic 'Vercel' look (e.g., make borders darker, change accent colors).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='complete-set-button').
Chart on History screen MUST use Recharts. Customize Recharts tooltip and axes to match the dark theme and orange accent.
Do not use completely transparent backgrounds on headers or bottom navigation overlays. Always use solid or heavily blurred (glassmorphism) backgrounds with low opacity.
Do not use `transition: all`. Specify exact properties like `transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease`.
instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React app with Tailwind CSS. Install lucide-react, recharts. Import 'Bebas Neue' from Google Fonts for headers. Use local storage mechanisms (e.g., IndexedDB/localStorage) for offline data storage. Build a standard 4-tab bottom nav layout. Apply styling exclusively using Tailwind utility classes.
